The depth of field transition is unnaturally abrupt. The topology mask shows minor edge irregularities at the base. These issues prevent a high artifact score, but the image is structurally coherent with no catastrophic melting or fusion. The score reflects a 'good but clearly AI-generated' aesthetic.
